DISHA 8.2 / DIRECT PAYMENT

Quantum Fusion

Choose a payment route. No account or amount entry is needed on this screen.

One touch creates a time-limited ₹1 test order using the authorized receiving account.

For P2P, DISHA issues a consent-bound payment request. For P2M, the authorized merchant workspace issues the amount and payment details. A verified receipt is shown only after matching transaction evidence arrives.
